title: test(driver-sql): pin the NODE_ENV=production auto-migrate guard with a safe drift, beside a dev control
body:
Fixes #24903

Clause-②: no (test only: no product code, accept set or served shape moves)

## What changed

One case in `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-schema-drift.test.ts` is re-staged, and a development control is added beside it. Test only: no product file moves.

- **Before:** "is force-disabled under NODE_ENV=production (warns, does not alter)" staged `relax_not_null`. ADR-0113 made that `needs_confirm`, and `reconcileAndWarnDrift` (`sql-driver.ts`) applies only `d.category === 'safe'`. So the column stayed NOT NULL with or without the production guard, and the case asserted no warning.
- **After:** the case stages a `safe` drift: a `current_user` runtime token written as the column DEFAULT by a pre-#4560 build, which `detectManagedDrift` classes `drop_column_default` / `safe`. Under `NODE_ENV=production` with `autoMigrate: 'safe'` it asserts:
  - the DEFAULT is still on the column (`columnInfo().owner.defaultValue` still carries `current_user`);
  - the drift is still reported as `safe` / `drop_column_default`, so the guard is the only thing that held it back;
  - `logger.warn` received `[schema-drift] autoMigrate='safe' is ignored under NODE_ENV=production`, matched on that stable prefix. The em-dash tail is left unpinned.
- **Control:** "applies the safe drop_column_default drift outside production (control for the guard below)". It is the same table and the same boot with `NODE_ENV=development`. The DEFAULT is removed, `detectManagedDrift()` answers `[]`, and no production warning is logged. The pair cannot pass vacuously again.
- `NODE_ENV` is restored in `finally` in both cases. The logger is a per-driver `vi.fn()` object (the file's own `makeDriver`), so no global spy is left to restore.

## Why `drop_column_default`

The `safe` ops `detectManagedDrift` emits on `main` (`schema-drift.ts`) are `drop_column_default`, `widen_varchar`, `replace_unique_index` and `create_index`.

- `widen_varchar` is gated on `enforcesVarcharLength` (postgres / mysql only), so it never fires on this file's SQLite driver.
- `create_index`: `syncTableIndexes` creates a missing declared index additively during `initObjects`, whatever `autoMigrate` says. The guard would not be the only reason it is absent.
- `replace_unique_index` works, but it needs a tenant-scoped unique field, an organization column and an index read-back. It is already the stage of `sql-driver-index-drift.test.ts`'s production case. PR #24893 is also rewriting the NULL-safe key part it compares.
- `drop_column_default` needs one column and one read-back, and stays in this file's `biz_unit` fixture idiom. The SQLite rebuild path applies it (`sql-driver-runtime-token-default.test.ts` measures that).

**PR #24893** (draft) edits `schema-drift.ts`. Its patch changes no `category:` line, and it does not touch the runtime-token default branch. It does not change which ops are `safe`.

## The guard, as read

`reconcileAndWarnDrift`: `autoOn = this.autoMigrate === 'safe' && this.schemaMode === 'managed'`, then `if (autoOn && this.isProductionEnv())`. `isProductionEnv()` is `(process.env.NODE_ENV ?? '').toLowerCase() === 'production'`, so the check is case-insensitive and reads nothing else. The warning goes out once per drifting table through `this.logger.warn`, not `console.warn`. The case spies on that logger.

## Verification (head `41b3fdf86`, `origin/main` merged at `19e5338cc`)

- **Target file:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/sql-driver-schema-drift.test.ts`: 15 passed (was 14).
- **Ablation:** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts --anchor 'if (autoOn && this.isProductionEnv()) {' --replacement 'if (false /* ABLATED-24903 */) {' -- vitest run` on that file.
  - Anchor hit x1 to x0, and the replacement landed x0 to x1. Blob `b4393f25d41b` became `98a32996463a`.
  - The production case went red: `AssertionError: expected 'null' to contain 'current_user'`. The control stayed green: 1 failed / 14 passed.
  - Restored: blob after restore = blob at HEAD = `b4393f25d41b`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - The test imports `SqlDriver` from `../src/index.js`, so no `dist/` rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.
- **Package checks:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql typecheck` exit 0, run before and after the merge. `tsc --listFiles` includes this test file.
- **Full suite:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql test` exit 0 before and after the merge: 225 files passed and 12 skipped (the live-dialect suites), 3692 tests passed.
- **Repo project:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo` exit 0: 6 files, 82 tests.
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gives 54 commands. All 54 were re-run on the final head with exit codes captured before any pipe: 54 of 54 exit 0 (26 direct node, 28 pnpm).
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET). They were re-run after `pnpm build` (76/76 tasks) and exited 0.
  - `--ran` reconciliation: 54 derived, 54 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero).
- **Changeset:** none. The test file is outside `@objectstack/driver-sql`'s `files[]` (`dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`). The built `dist/` has zero hits for the test file name, and the positive control (the warning text) hits `dist/index.js`. `skip-changeset` is declared in the same create.

## Acceptance notes

- **Pin sweep:** the warning text and the guard were swept across every package, `qa/`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` and `content/docs/`.
  - The only other pin of the driver-level guard is `sql-driver-index-drift.test.ts`, "is force-disabled under NODE_ENV=production — the index survives untouched". It stages `replace_unique_index` (`safe`) beside a dev self-heal sibling, so it is **not** vacuous. It does not assert the warning. Noted, not built.
  - The CLI / runtime pins (`dev-self-heal-host-parity`, `runtime/src/dev-auto-migrate`, `dev-standalone-self-heal`) pin a different layer: the host does not pass `autoMigrate` in production. They do not pin this driver branch.
  - `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json` names the warning in a live-boot step and carries this case as `knownGaps`. Re-adding the case to `cli.dev-automigrate-policy`'s `automated.ref` is `domain:devx`'s, and is not touched here.
